params.message:
Composer and npm locks past four security advisories

The dependency audits fail every pull request since these advisories
landed. Only the lock files change; every version stays within the
ranges composer.json and package.json already allow.

Composer:
- symfony/http-foundation 8.1.4 -> 8.1.9, CVE-2026-108082 (ReDoS in
  HeaderUtils::split() through the Cache-Control request header).
- symfony/yaml 8.1.2 -> 8.1.9, CVE-2026-109413 (unbounded recursion in
  the inline lexer); only laravel/roster, a dev tool, pulls it in.
- The polyfills mbstring and php80 move along as their dependencies.

npm (both build or dev-server only, neither reaches the browser bundle):
- follow-redirects 1.16.0 -> 1.16.1, GHSA-q3jh-wrc6-jgq8 and
  GHSA-8r9p-f939-6h3c (credential headers kept across redirects).
- vite 8.2.x -> 8.3.5, launch-editor GHSA-698v-4r3x-3vcv,
  GHSA-r825-w8mm-5pxw and GHSA-587h-7wmj-h5pm.
